about: How long a vacancy waits before anyone can fill it (posting, applications, interviews, a start date): the openings-to-hires ratio of the firm's industry, in months, with the 45-month range as its spread. A firm's own duration sits inside that range by its world offset, never a roll. Firm size is not read (SG-LABOR-vacancy-size-uniform).

total-private.source: BLS JOLTS seasonally adjusted job openings level over hires level, monthly, Jan 2023 to Sep 2026 (45 months), FRED series JTS1000JOL / JTS1000HIL (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/JTS1000JOL). The ratio of the openings stock to the month's hires is the months a vacancy waits to be filled (Davis, Faberman and Haltiwanger 2013, 'The Establishment-Level Behavior of Vacancies and Hiring', QJE 128(2): vacancy duration is the openings stock over the hiring flow).
